asdd_mode.description: When true, the project uses Agentic Spec-Driven Development (tasks live in bd, not tasks.md).

spec_strict.description: Master switch: enables strict ASDD enforcement (hooks, lint, preflight).

spec_strict_no_tasks_md.description: When true, the PreToolUse hook rejects writes to tasks.md and gemba constitution lint reports their presence as an error. Inherits spec_strict by default.
